statement: Speedrun goes from a fresh account to killing Amarok; the rules are a general guideline anyone can follow
Timer starts when you press create character on a fresh account; the prologue is not part of the run
No guilds and no parties; party dungeons are allowed but solo only
The lava achievement is banned; you can't use anything gained from it during the run
Gem shop can be opened but nothing can be purchased from it; this stops wallet warrior and time candy buying
No events can be running during the speedrun because they create unreasonable time differences
In-game music must be playing to avoid splicing and keep the run valid
Apart from these conditions you are free to do whatever you want and can theorycraft to save time
